sun_jupiter_ganymede_kepler_lc_ssf5.description: Sun/Jupiter/Ganymede, Kepler LC (29.4 min) with 5x supersampling, 3 epochs, per_bary != epoch_distance (drift); mutual eclipse at mid-transit of epoch 0; planet via occult_hybrid (k=0.103), moon via occult_small.

sun_jupiter_ganymede_kepler_sc_nocache_l.description: Sun/Jupiter/Ganymede, Kepler SC (58.8 s), pandora() without cache (all bodies via occult_hybrid); mutual eclipse while the planet crosses the stellar limb (analytic limb path).

sun_earth_luna_plato_1min.description: Sun/Earth/Luna, PLATO 1 min cadence, 2 epochs; mutual eclipse at mid-transit of epoch 0; planet via the occultation cache (k=0.0091), moon via occult_small.

sun_jupiter_earthmoon_tess_2min.description: Sun/Jupiter/Earth-sized exomoon (P=3 d), TESS 2 min, 2 epochs; mutual eclipse at mid-transit of epoch 0; moon via the occultation cache (k=0.0091).

sun_jupiter_eccentric_moon_tess_200s.description: Sun/Jupiter/large icy moon (2 R_Ganymede), the only eccentric moon (e=0.5, w=60 deg, i=88.5 deg, Omega=5 deg), TESS 200 s FFI, 2 epochs; tau puts the late-orbit phase (approach to periapsis) and a mutual eclipse in transit; moon via cache.

mdwarf_neptune_earthmoon_tess_20s.description: M dwarf (0.3 R_sun)/Neptune/Earth-sized moon (P=1.137 d), eccentric planet orbit (e=0.1, w=40 deg), TESS 20 s, 3 epochs; k_planet=0.118 (occult_hybrid), k_moon=0.030 (cache); mutual eclipse at mid-transit of epoch 0.

sun_jupiter_grazing_kepler_sc.description: Grazing Sun/Jupiter transit (b=1.0, planet centre on the limb), Ganymede, Kepler SC; mutual eclipse on the limb (analytic limb path; the on-star part of the moon is always fully behind the planet disk, so the moon flux is exactly 1), case-III boundary geometry throughout.

giant_earth_luna_tess_10min.description: Red giant (10 R_sun)/Earth/Luna, TESS 10 min FFI; k_planet=0.0009 is below the cache grid (routed to occult_small, bug #3), k_moon=0.00025; ~6 d transit; mutual eclipse at mid-transit.

sun_jupiter_unphysical_moon_plato_1min.description: Sun/Jupiter with a moon on a 400 d orbit (outside the Hill sphere): Pandora's plausibility check removes the moon; planet-only transit, PLATO 1 min.

sun_jupiter_neptunemoon_kepler_lc_ssf3_n.description: Sun/Jupiter/Neptune-sized moon ('binary planet', P=2 d), Kepler LC with 3x supersampling, no cache (both via occult_hybrid), t0_bary_offset=0.02 d, drift, numerical_grid=51; mutual eclipse during ingress (limb).

sun_jupiter_neptunemoon_kepler_lc_ssf3_p.description: As case 10 (Jupiter/Neptune-sized moon, Kepler LC, 3x supersampling, no cache), fluxes from pandora_flux() (culls samples that cannot be in transit; coordinates for the fingerprint from pandora()), epoch windows 3x wider (slack 3.0).

sun_jupiter_eccentric_moon_tess_200s_pan.description: As case 5 (eccentric moon e=0.5, TESS 200 s, 2 epochs) without cache, fluxes from the float32 deficits of pandora_deficit() (flux = 1 - deficit; float32 rounding <= 6e-8 of the deficit), epoch windows 2x wider (slack 2.5).

note_2026_10_13: cleanup: cases 11/12 (pixelmap) removed; numerical_grid / eclipse_method removed from the case parameters; fingerprints of the other cases unchanged (from 430f8fc)
